messages:
maria: Heads up — PR #9876 touches tiling/prefetch logic in KV cache and is gated until we attach an arch/RFC link. I added the RFC here: https://redwood.ai/rfcs/tiling-prefetch-2026. TL;DR: changes to shard key derivation with a backward-compatible fallback but could influence warmup tail latency. Need an arch quick-bless so we can schedule a canary.
jun: skimmed the RFC, looks reasonable. Can you add explicit SLO deltas and a rollback/canary plan to the PR description? That'll help us approve fast.
maria: done — added a short canary plan and the SLO numbers to the PR. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, 99.9% tail tokens/sec, cache-hit ratio. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9876. Hoping for arch eyes by EOD so we can merge tomorrow morning.
oliver: pinging arch folks for quick eyes — @sachin @harper
sachin: quick question — how does the fallback behave if the new sharding misses? Also, any perf numbers for 8k sequences?
maria: fallback routes to the prior sharding logic transparently; I added a bench table to the RFC. Worst-case cold start p95 is ~+3% on 8k sequences, warm-cache unaffected.
harper: quick read: KV namespace change could cause cross-pod invalidations. Do we have a migration/mittigation strategy (dual-write, draining, etc.)?
maria: yes — added a migration outline: dual-write flag, background migration job, and a short ops playbook. Notified eng-infra.
jun: from product/serving POV I'm fine if arch signs off. Proposal: 1 hour canary in low-traffic window (01:00–02:00 UTC) with auto-rollback if p95 > +5%.
arch-bot: ARCH-REVIEW REQUIRED: Please attach RFC/arch brief to unblock merge.
deploy-bot: Deploy window tentative: 2026-03-19 01:00-02:00 UTC. Canary flag: --canary=9876. Rollback command: `deploy rollback --pr 9876`.
sachin: I'll give final LGTM after a small RFC header about KMS interactions (we don't expect key changes but document it).
maria: added a KMS section to the RFC (no keys changed, note-only). Thanks sachin.
oliver: infra OK from my side. leaving final arch signoff to sachin for merge.
sachin: LGTM — I'll add a comment on the PR and hit merge once CI passes.
maria: thanks all :tada:
